rows.grounds: first member of compound qualifying sāram
second member of compound; describes Mañjughoṣa as essence of all
act of reverence performed by speaker

items.question: What qualities of Mañjughoṣa make him worthy of the speaker's salutation?
premises: Mañjughoṣa is characterized as the essence of all.
The speaker performs an act of bowing to Mañjughoṣa.
items.inference: Because Mañjughoṣa embodies joy and the essence of all, the speaker offers him reverent salutation.
items.plain_english: I bow to Mañjughoṣa, who is joyful and the essence of all.
